shortDescription: Manage IP address properties on Solaris/illumos systems.

options.name: addrobj
options.description: Specifies the address object we want to manage.

options.name: property
options.description: Specifies the name of the address property we want to manage.

options.name: state
options.description: Set or reset the property value.

options.name: temporary
options.description: Specifies that the address property value is temporary. Temporary values do not persist across reboots.

options.name: value
options.description: Specifies the value we want to set for the address property.
